_comment: Rudder — private, offline, streaming voice-to-text. DESKTOP target: the speech model runs in the local backend (backend/rudder-engine: NVIDIA NeMo-Speech.cpp + Nemotron 3.5 ASR GGUF), started by `bun run dev` and run by Tauri as a sidecar. Not for public web embeds: a website has no local engine.
